_azure_list_prices.source_note: LIST prices (USD per Mtok), NOT billed amounts. Azure OpenAI standard (global) pay-as-you-go list prices as retrieved 2026-10-12 from third-party trackers that mirror https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/azure-openai/ (the Azure page is client-rendered and not machine-readable): gpt-4.1 $2.00 in / $8.00 out; gpt-4.1-mini $0.40 / $1.60; gpt-4o-mini $0.15 / $0.60; gpt-5-mini $0.25 / $2.00 (sources: pricepertoken.com, helicone.ai/llm-cost, openrouter.ai model pages, all 2026-10-12). Cached-input rates are the published OpenAI/Azure cached-input list prices (gpt-4.1 $0.50, gpt-4.1-mini $0.10, gpt-4o-mini $0.075, gpt-5-mini $0.025); I could not re-verify these four against the Azure page itself. OpenAI-style models have no cache-write surcharge, so cache_write_5m is set equal to input. Reasoning tokens are billed as output and are already inside completion_tokens. The user's actual Azure bill is not visible; the cost is reported in its own bucket and is uncapped by user decision.
